description:
You are a fire department training officer preparing an After-Action Report (AAR). The document at /home/ga/Documents/aar_draft.docx contains the raw text of a multi-alarm structure fire report, but it is poorly formatted (Courier New, no headings, no tables). 

Reformat this document and save it as /home/ga/Documents/aar_formatted.docx (do NOT modify the original draft). 

Required formatting:
1. Apply 'Heading 1' style to these section headers: 'Incident Summary', 'Incident Timeline', 'Tactical Operations', 'Personnel and Equipment', 'Findings and Recommendations', 'Conclusion'.
2. Apply 'Heading 2' style to these subsection headers: 'Fire Suppression', 'Search and Rescue', 'Ventilation', 'Recommendations for Training'.
3. Convert the plaintext timeline in the 'Incident Timeline' section into a 3-column table with headers 'Time', 'Unit/Source', 'Action/Description'. Remove the original text lines after creating the table.
4. Set all page margins (top, bottom, left, right) to 1.0 inch.
5. Center-align the first two paragraphs (Title and Subtitle).
6. Set all body text (non-heading paragraphs) to Liberation Sans (or Arial) at 11pt.
7. Add a footer containing the page number.
8. Save the result to /home/ga/Documents/aar_formatted.docx.
